06/22.03.2023 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Lohardaga P. S. Case No. 123/2022,
registered under Sections 406/ 420 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned C.J.M., Lohardaga.
Petitioner was a recovery agent in Shri Ram Finance Corporation Limited.

He collected 7,50,000/-
from various customers of the company and misappropriated the said amount.
Statement of the customers has been recorded in paragraphs 72 and 73 of the case diary.
They have stated that they had handed over their monthly installments to the petitioner which was not deposited by him.
Learned lawyer appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner had very diligently and honestly performed his duty.
It was further submitted that the senior officer of the company used to compel him to misappropriate the collected amount.
When he refused, this false case has been instituted.
Considering the gravity and nature of the offence, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on Anticipatory Bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for anticipatory bail stands rejected.
The petitioner, if so, advised may surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of the copy of this order and pray for regular bail.
